summary: Layout (Digital): the committed routed GDS of the LibreLane flow (gds workflow run 38136727636 at 6dd0e9d: TinyTapeout/tt-gds-action@ihp-cmos5l, LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3, IHP-Open-PDK 2bbec755), placed and routed from the LibreLane gate-level netlist reference-asrouted.v by the committed flow (.github/workflows/gds.yaml, src/config.json, src/pdn_cfg.tcl, info.yaml). The design carries DR 0015's P1/P2 (issue #208), the UART-load boot ROM (issue #139), the load-phase CRC readout on uo_out (issue #137), the UART load's count-complement check (issue #211, 232-word boot ROM), the open-drain pad-data fix of DR 0020 (issue #244) and the LibreLane timing-repair keys of issue #246. DRC/LVS of these bytes: librelane-gds-signoff-check 20261011-144308-e5a0bae. Refreshed for issues #208/#139, #137, #211 and #244/#246; first written by issue #83.
